query.title: Company/business name or registration number
query.description: A single company/business name (or partial name) or Solomon Islands Business Registry number (e.g. 20111873 for a company, BN20030195 for a business name) to search for.

queries.title: Company/business names or registration numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/registration numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

register.title: Register to search
register.description: Restrict the search to one register. "Any" searches Companies, Business Names, and Foreign Investments together.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full entity profile
fetchDetails.description: When on (default), each matched entity is opened to pull its full public profile -- addresses, directors, shareholders, and filing history. When off, only the search-result summary (name, registration number, status, incorporation date, sector) is returned, which is faster for a broad name search.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities to return (and, if enabled, fetch full profiles for) per search query. The register only returns a single results page per search (no pagination), so a very broad query may not surface every match.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search sessions to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
